title: Key truth
description: One of the few revelations that matter in the book: a fact the reader does not know at first and learns at a precise point. A book has a handful, not hundreds. `evidence` cites the paragraphs of the reveal.

text.description: The truth as one self-contained sentence in the book's language: full names, an explicit verb, one fact.

revealed_at.description: First paragraph after which a reader may know the truth. Never before the earliest evidence. Spoiler-safe features show the truth only to a reader past this point; a paragraph that is `revealed_at` of a truth is a spoiler for anyone who has not reached it.

clues.description: Earlier paragraphs that hint at the truth before it is revealed (planted clues). All before `revealed_at`.
